stock.description: Yik Wo International Holdings Limited is a company focused on the entire lifecycle of disposable plastic food storage solutions, from their initial design and development through to manufacturing and sales. These products are primarily offered to consumers under its JAZZIT brand, with distribution spanning both the People's Republic of China and various international markets. The enterprise, which commenced operations in 2011, underwent a name change in February 2019, rebranding from its former identity, Yihe International Holdings Limited, to its current one. Yik Wo International Holdings Limited maintains its corporate headquarters in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Prize Investment Limited.
